mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_route WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_route (order_id, seq, station_id, arrive_trip_no, planned_time, actual_arrive_time, arrive_operator_id, postman_id, status, remark) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{seq}, #{stationId}, #{arriveTripNo}, #{plannedTime}, #{actualArriveTime}, #{arriveOperatorId}, #{postmanId}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.state AS orderState, r.seq AS seq, o.forward_station_count AS forwardStationCount, CASE WHEN r.seq = o.forward_station_count THEN dest.name ELSE COALESCE(prev_station.name, origin.name) END AS fromStationName, CASE WHEN r.seq = o.forward_station_count THEN CONCAT('收件人 ', o.receiver_name) ELSE dest.name END AS toStationName, r.arrive_trip_no AS tripNo, r.depart_time AS departTime, r.actual_arrive_time AS arriveTime, r.status AS legStatus, o.sender_name AS senderName, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.goods_desc AS goodsDesc FROM order_route r JOIN delivery_order o ON o.id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN order_route prev ON prev.order_id = r.order_id AND prev.seq = r.seq - 1 LEFT JOIN station prev_station ON prev_station.id = prev.station_id LEFT JOIN station origin ON origin.id = o.from_station_id JOIN station dest ON dest.id = r.station_id WHERE r.postman_id = #{postmanId} AND o.state IN #{s} ORDER BY r.id DESC
